entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""With Duchess Azaro now... indispos..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Duchess Azaro now... indisposed, it is imperative that you choose a new security councilor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is she faring in prison, by th..."
entries.dialogueText: "How is she faring in prison, by the way?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""She's in a high-end women's facili..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's in a high-end women's facility within the Porte Drazon Citadel. I would not worry about her treatment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was going to ask you about that...."
entries.dialogueText: "I was going to ask you about that. Have you found any suitable candidates?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want a councilor who isn't a tra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want a councilor who isn't a traitor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You mean a new war councilor.""
entries.dialogueText: "You mean a new war councilor."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We have avoided a second Pales con..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have avoided a second Pales conflict. Lord willing, we will not be entering another war."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A perfectly reasonable expectation.""
entries.dialogueText: "A perfectly reasonable expectation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Two, in fact.""
entries.dialogueText: "Two, in fact."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As to candidates for her successor..."
entries.dialogueText: "As to candidates for her successor..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Incredibly, it seems that General..."
entries.dialogueText: "Incredibly, it seems that General Taddeus Azaro is on track to make a full recovery."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Give him another few months, and h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give him another few months, and he will be ready to resume his former position."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He still wants to serve me after I..."
entries.dialogueText: "He still wants to serve me after I jailed his daughter?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why, that's excellent news. It'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, that's excellent news. It'll be as if this whole unpleasantness with Lucita never occurred."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh. I must say that I dread that p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. I must say that I dread that prospect, especially given the circumstances."

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""General Taddeus is not one to forg..."
entries.dialogueText: "General Taddeus is not one to forgive and forget, Your Majesty. But you have been a friend to his house throughout your reign."

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Apparently. Which surprises me, gi..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You have been a friend to House Az..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have been a friend to House Azaro. Perhaps enough so that he is willing to overlook this incident."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He has shown exceptional loyalty t..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has shown exceptional loyalty to the Crown in the past. But now? I confess I am not certain."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have no doubt of his loyalty to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no doubt of his loyalty to the Crown. As long as you keep his daughter alive, of course."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would never execute Duchess Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would never execute Duchess Azaro. I still harbor fond feelings for her, you know."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I would never execute Duchess Azar..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would never execute Duchess Azaro. All of Cardesse-Montaklar would turn on me in an instant."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Palesians will be expecting an..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians will be expecting an execution, won't they?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As long as treason to Rizia is pun..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as treason to Rizia is punishable by death, then yes, they will take umbrage if you make an exception."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If that is what you insist, then I..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is what you insist, then I suggest you keep General Taddeus far from these halls."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes, ordering the death of such a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, ordering the death of such a prominent noble is bound to have repercussions. Even if her father is not restored to his former position."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I suspected the two of you were cl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suspected the two of you were close. It's for the best that nothing came of it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do have one other qualified cand..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do have one other qualified candidate in mind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So what you're saying is that I sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "So what you're saying is that I should throw him in jail as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The man's a patriot. He knows that..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man's a patriot. He knows that Rizia's security comes before his petty familial concerns."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He got us into an unnecessary war...."
entries.dialogueText: "He got us into an unnecessary war. I'm not chomping at the bit to have him back."

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Is that so, Your Majesty? The Gene..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so, Your Majesty? The General may not be one to forgive and forget, but you have secured House Azaro's favor up to this point."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I don't blame you. House Azaro had..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't blame you. House Azaro had qualms about your reign even before you jailed their heiress."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The man's a patriot. He knows that..."
entries.dialogueText: "The man's a patriot. He knows that Rizia's security comes before his petty familial concerns."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On the other hand... he got us int..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand... he got us into an unnecessary war. I'm not chomping at the bit to have him back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On the other hand... the uprising..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand... the uprising was his fault. I'm not chomping at the bit to have him back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aside from that, the uprising was..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aside from that, the uprising was his fault. I'm not chomping at the bit to have him back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And what repercussions can I expec..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what repercussions can I expect from the Azaros if I don't give him his council seat back?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""One would hope so.""
entries.dialogueText: "One would hope so."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He was instrumental in restoring s..."
entries.dialogueText: "He was instrumental in restoring stability after the conflict. Two decades without a major incident is nothing to sniff at."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The uprising had many causes. And..."
entries.dialogueText: "The uprising had many causes. And the General was instrumental in restoring stability afterwards."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Obviously, they would prefer it if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously, they would prefer it if the council seat went to their house. But they will understand if you have lingering concerns about the General's health."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled darkly."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled darkly.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not unless you want all of Cardess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not unless you want all of Cardesse-Montaklar rioting in the streets."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It is more complicated than that...."
entries.dialogueText: "It is more complicated than that. House Azaro and national security have been synonymous for many years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus already commands his own sec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus already commands his own security detail. Naming him councilor would only be natural."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus already has an important ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus already has an important assignment. I don't want to dilute his focus by putting him on the council."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded towards the door."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded towards the door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That meathead, in charge of securi..."
entries.dialogueText: "That meathead, in charge of security? I want him taking bullets for me, not commanding our armies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know Titus is still sore I never..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know Titus is still sore I never expanded the Golden Guard. Naming him security councilor would more than make up for that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A security councilor with no house..."
entries.dialogueText: "A security councilor with no house and no agenda to push... It could be a refreshing change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Titus? Really? What makes you thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Titus? Really? What makes you think he can be trusted?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He has been by your side since you..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has been by your side since your coronation. And his conduct has been beyond reproach."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Such loyalty should not go unrewar..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such loyalty should not go unrewarded."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps his unconventional backgro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps his unconventional background will give him an edge in devising national security strategies."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Captain Gordion is a professional...."
entries.dialogueText: "Captain Gordion is a professional. He would not resent you for a decision you made so early on in your reign."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""His services have been indispensab..."
entries.dialogueText: "His services have been indispensable in keeping the Royal Family safe. And what is Rizia, if not one extended royal family?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""On the other hand, concentrating t..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, concentrating that much power in the hands of one man could prove dangerous."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""His conduct as head of the Golden..."
entries.dialogueText: "His conduct as head of the Golden Guard has been beyond reproach."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""With Rizia's national security app..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Rizia's national security apparatus at his disposal, he could easily handle both."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am confident he would make as tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am confident he would make as trustworthy a councilor as he has a bodyguard."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's true that he has no experienc..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true that he has no experience with military operations. But then again, we are not at war."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He smiled."
entries.dialogueText: He smiled.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At any rate, I will leave the deci..."
entries.dialogueText: "At any rate, I will leave the decision up to you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You may not know this, but Captain..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may not know this, but Captain Gordion petitioned King Valero about the interim security councilor position after General Azaro fell ill."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's interesting. What'd my fath..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's interesting. What'd my father say?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He appeared interested. However, h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He appeared interested. However, he signed the order for Duchess Azaro to fill the position without so much as interviewing the Captain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father should have said yes. Lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father should have said yes. Look what happened with Lucita."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He couldn't have known. None of us..."
entries.dialogueText: "He couldn't have known. None of us did."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That power-grubber. My father neve..."
entries.dialogueText: "That power-grubber. My father never even expanded the Golden Guard."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps he would have, had he live..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps he would have, had he lived."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But my father didn't think he was..."
entries.dialogueText: "But my father didn't think he was ready yet."

entries.dialogueText: "He said no such thing. He told me he was considering the possibility, in fact. But House Azaro took precedence."
